svg.aria-label: Stack. Cloud: AWS (EC2, S3, Lambda, IAM, VPC, EMR, Kinesis, Systems Manager). Infrastructure: Terraform, Terragrunt, cloud-init, Proxmox, Tailscale. Containers and CI/CD: Kubernetes (k3s), Docker, Argo CD, Atlantis, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Git. Observability: CloudWatch, Prometheus, Grafana, PagerDuty, on-call. Languages and systems: Python (boto3), Bash, Linux, systemd, TypeScript, JavaScript, SQL. Data: Redshift, RDS, Hive, MySQL, MongoDB, Apache Airflow, SQLite. AI and apps: FastAPI, React, PyTorch, LoRA (PEFT), sentence-transformers, ChromaDB, Ollama.
